items: six forbidden-claim ids: spatial_pattern_from_one_correlation, agreement_from_uncertain_correlation, review_set_for_unthresholded_regression, one_reference_settles_two_dates, evidence_outside_its_scope, certification_guaranteed
a correlation is a fact with n and a 95% interval (Fisher's z), and must_state says one correlation says nothing about where two maps agree
evidence that does not cover the case keeps its figures and dataset names in the evidence file only
a review set listed short writes its full ranked list to a CSV and names it; the evidence file is said to hold no windows
margin_ratio names the windows it covers and gives the first ten listed their own ratio
estimate_map_error gives weakest_classes computed by code; a random design makes certification possible, not certain
the harness gains a detector per new id, a stricter subset-labelling detector, and a check that a file named as holding a list holds it
